name: Kendra
source:
Kendra is a demoness who lives in the Hell kingdom. She enjoys bringing terror to places unprotected by guardians.
Unlike her sister [url=/c102400]Maryen[/url], she is Cruel and playful. This giant demoness also kidnaps people for use as toys or to sell them. It´s dangerous to stay close to her...
